messages:
Alex: Heading to the Brooklyn office next Tue — any quick ramen spots near Atlantic Terminal or good team-lunch places nearby? Need spots that can do a table for 6 and not take >45m. Open to pizza, ramen, casual. Thanks! 🙏
Maya: Ramen Takara on Flatbush is solid, about a 10 min walk. Small place but amazing. For groups, Basil & Brooklyn has bigger tables and decent pasta.
Jenn: Atlantic Pizza Co. has huge slices and a roomy back area — super fast. Also Sushi Ikkoku is nearby if folks want sushi. 🍣
Ravi: @Alex if you want delivery to the office I can handle ordering on Seamless — what's the per-person budget?
Alex: Budget around $20-25pp. Prefer sit-down for team vibes but delivery is fine if seating is tight.
Sam: For ramen, try Brooklyn Ichiban (might have a small private-ish corner) or Baohaus for quick baos — both are ~10-15m walk.
Maya: Quick list from my notes:
```
- Ramen Takara (Flatbush) - 10m walk
- Atlantic Pizza Co. - big slices, roomy
- Baohaus - fast, 12m
- Basil & Brooklyn - reservations possible
```
Link: https://short.link/bk-eats
CateringBot: Reminder: if you'd like a catered lunch, submit the form at https://redwood.gig/catering (lead time 48h) :calendar:
Alex: Awesome, I'll poll the team and lock something by Friday. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
